```python
def _get_item_length(item, parents_ids=frozenset([])):
    item_id = id(item)
    if item_id in parents_ids:
        return 0
    
    parents_ids = add_to_frozen_set(parents_ids, item_id)
    
    if isinstance(item, dict):
        length = len(item)
        for key, value in item.items():
            length += _get_item_length(key, parents_ids)
            length += _get_item_length(value, parents_ids)
        return length
    elif isinstance(item, (list, tuple)):
        length = len(item)
        for sub_item in item:
            length += _get_item_length(sub_item, parents_ids)
        return length
    elif isinstance(item, set):
        length = len(item)
        for sub_item in item:
            length += _get_item_length(sub_item, parents_ids)
        return length
    elif isinstance(item, str):
        return 1
    elif isinstance(item, (int, float, bool, type(None))):
        return 1
    elif isinstance(item, Mapping):
        length = len(item)
        for key, value in item.items():
            length += _get_item_length(key, parents_ids)
            length += _get_item_length(value, parents_ids)
        return length
    elif isinstance(item, Iterable) and not isinstance(item, (str, bytes)):
        length = 0
        try:
            for sub_item in item:
                length += _get_item_length(sub_item, parents_ids)
            return length
        except TypeError:
            return 1
    else:
        length = 0
        try:
            for key, value in item.__dict__.items():
                length += 1
                length += _get_item_length(value, parents_ids)
        except (AttributeError, TypeError):
            pass
        return max(1, length)
```

```python
def _get_rough_distance(self):
    _distance = get_numeric_types_distance(
        self.t1, self.t2, max_=self.cutoff_distance_for_pairs, use_log_scale=self.use_log_scale, log_scale_similarity_threshold=self.log_scale_similarity_threshold)

    if _distance is not not_found:
        return _distance

    item = self if self.view == DELTA_VIEW else self._to_delta_dict(report_repetition_required=False)
    diff_length = _get_item_length(item)

    if diff_length == 0:
        return 0

    t1_len = self.__get_item_rough_length(self.t1)
    t2_len = self.__get_item_rough_length(self.t2)

    return diff_length / (t1_len + t2_len)
```

```python
def __calculate_item_deephash(self, item):
    DeepHash(
        item,
        hashes=self.hashes,
        parent='root',
        apply_hash=True,
        **self.deephash_parameters,
    )
```
